overview.oneLineTake: Surging Treasury yields and deteriorating credit conditions are overwhelming AI-driven tech resilience, creating a fragile, bifurcated market with rising tail risk and single-stock dispersion.
themes: Relentless bond rout pushes 10Y Treasury yields to 24-year highs, crushing broad market breadth and corporate debt affordability
AI mega-cap resilience creates extreme bifurcation; the "AI put" props Nasdaq while nearly half the S&P 500 languishes in bear markets
Corporate credit stress intensifies via Paramount’s distressed $30B financing, rising bankruptcies, and global private-credit gating fears
Plunging consumer confidence (lowest since 2014) clashes with sticky core inflation and hawkish Fed rhetoric, keeping financial conditions tight
risks: Credit event risk from sustained high yields squeezing leveraged corporates and real estate exposures
Energy supply shock tail risk from Iran tensions and potential U.S. diesel export restrictions
2000-style divergence between calm index volatility and spiking single-stock volatility signaling fragility in narrow leadership
